suppressions.reason: Two-layer board with a single GND pour on B.Cu. Nets routed on B.Cu score 0-40% 'plane coverage' because the rule looks for copper on the opposite layer; their actual return is the coplanar pour surrounding them. Composite video (~6 MHz) does not need a dedicated reference plane.
USB-C1 is a power-only receptacle (USB4125-GF-A-0190) with no data pins to filter. J2 is a 75-ohm composite audio/video output where series filtering would degrade the signal.
PJRAN1X1U03X right-angle RCA jacks are edge-mounted by design; the courtyard overhang is connector body, not copper. All 37 pads verified inside the board outline.

VBUS bulk capacitance is intentionally downstream of F1 and U1: C3 (100nF) bypasses the eFuse input and C1 (100uF) sits on the protected /5V output. No cap on the unprotected connector side is deliberate.
D1 (1.5KE6.8A TVS, cathode to rail) protects /5V downstream of the PTC and eFuse. Accepted design: the connector-side VBUS pins are unclamped.
raw_5v is USB-C VBUS straight off the connector; its only pins are passive (USB-C1.A9/B9 and F1.2), so ERC sees no declared source. PWR_FLAG sits on fused_5v instead. Annotation only.
The 8 BOM lines without an MPN (C1, C2, R1, R2, R3/R4, R5/R7, J4, J5) are through-hole passives harvested from the v1 board. LCSC part numbers cover the assembly lines.
